db-fd-closure-08: Sirf $\{B, C\}$ se shuru karke closure banana hai. Har FD tabhi fire hoga jab uska poora LHS set mein ho.
Repeat karo: set mein jo FD ka poora LHS ho, uska RHS jodo. Yahan BD → E ke liye B aur D dono chahiye, aur G → F ke liye G.
C → D se set $\{B, C, D\}$ bana. Ab dekho BD → E fire hota hai ya nahi, phir E se aage. Trap: maan lena ki closure saare 7 attributes tak pahunchega.
db-fd-closure-09: Ek FD redundant tab hai jab use hata kar bhi baaki FDs se wahi nikal aaye. Har option alag se, akela hata kar test karo.
Rule: X → Y hatao, baaki F se $X^+$ nikaalo. Agar Y ⊆ $X^+$, to wo FD redundant hai.
A → C hata kar $A^+$: A → B, B → C, ... chalao. C → D hata kar $C^+$ nikaalo — AC → D tab fire hoga kya? Trap: AC → D ke liye A bhi chahiye.
db-fd-keys-07: Pehle dekho kaun se attributes kisi FD ke right side pe kabhi nahi aate — wo har key mein hone chahiye.
RHS par B, D, E aate hain, to A aur C kahin RHS pe nahi. Ab $(AC)^+$ nikaalo aur check karo ki ABCDE banta hai.
$(AC)^+$: A → B se B mila, ab BC → D ka poora LHS hai. Aage chalao. Trap: {A, B, C} superkey hai par minimal nahi.
db-fd-keys-08: E kisi RHS pe nahi hai — ye har key ka hissa hoga. Phir dekho E ke saath kya-kya jodna padta hai.
$E^+ = \{A, E\}$. Ab B, C ya D me se ek-ek jod kar closure nikaalo; cycle C → D → B dhyan se dekho.
$(BE)^+$: E → A, phir AB → C, C → D. Ab CE aur DE bhi try karo aur gino kitni keys bani. Trap: A ko prime maan lena sirf isliye ki wo LHS pe hai.
db-fd-keys-09: Superkey = koi bhi set jiska closure poora R ho. Pehle saari candidate keys nikaalo, phir unke supersets gino.
Keys: A, aur BC (BC → A → DE). Supersets of A $= 2^4$, supersets of BC $= 2^3$; jo dono me hain unhe ek baar hi gino.
Dono me common sets = jinme A, B, C teeno hon: baaki D, E free, to $2^2$. Ab inclusion–exclusion lagao. Trap: common sets ko do baar gin lena.
db-nf-test-07: Highest normal form ke liye pehle candidate key nikaalo, phir dekho B → D ka LHS key ka poora hissa hai ya sirf ek part.
A, B kisi RHS pe nahi, $(AB)^+$ = ABCD, to key AB. 2NF: koi non-prime attribute key ke proper subset pe depend na kare.
D non-prime hai aur B key AB ka proper subset hai. Ab socho ye kaunsa NF todta hai. Trap: B → D ko transitive samajhna.
db-nf-test-08: BCNF test: har nontrivial FD ka LHS superkey ho. Har relation ke liye pehle uski keys nikaalo.
Har option me har FD ka LHS lo, uska closure ABC hai ya nahi dekho. Sirf 'saare attributes prime hain' se BCNF nahi milta.
R1: $B^+$ = B → A → C, to B bhi key hai. Isi tarah R2 me $C^+$ aur R4 me $B^+$ nikaalo. Trap: all-prime ko BCNF maan lena.
db-nf-test-09: 3NF violation: X → A jahan X superkey nahi AUR A prime bhi nahi. Iske liye saari keys aur prime attributes chahiye.
A kisi RHS pe nahi. $(AB)^+$ aur $(AC)^+$ dono nikaalo (C → B dhyan do). Prime attributes = keys ke union me.
Keys AB aur AC hain, to prime = A, B, C. Ab har FD par do sawal: LHS superkey? RHS prime? Trap: C → B ko gin lena — B prime hai.
db-decomp-07: Lossless binary test: dono parts ka common attribute set kisi ek part ki key hona chahiye. Har option ka intersection dekho.
Rule: $(R_1 \cap R_2)^+ \supseteq R_1$ ya $\supseteq R_2$. F me sirf B → CD hai, to $C^+ = \{C\}$.
Pehla option: common = B, $B^+$ = BCD. Baaki options ka common attribute kya hai aur uska closure kya hai, dekho. Trap: common attribute hona hi kaafi maan lena.
db-decomp-08: Preservation = har FD parts ke projected FDs se nikalna chahiye, join kiye bina. Jo FD ek part me poora nahi baitha, use test karo.
Test X → Y: Z = X; har part $R_i$ ke liye Z ∪= ($(Z \cap R_i)^+ \cap R_i$); repeat. Y ⊆ Z to preserved.
C → A: Z = {C}; R2 se B mila, phir R1 se A. Ab AD → E ke liye Z = {A, D} se shuru karo aur R4 pe dhyan do. Trap: C → A ko lost maan lena.
db-decomp-09: Chaar general statements hain — har ek ko 3NF synthesis, BCNF splitting aur lossless test ke rules se milao.
Yaad: 3NF synthesis = lossless + preserving. BCNF = hamesha lossless, preserving zaroori nahi. Lossless binary: $(R_1 \cap R_2) \to R_1$ ya $R_2$.
Last statement ke liye counterexample socho: R(A, B, C, D), F = {A → B, C → D}, split {AB, CD} — preserving hai, par common attribute kya hai? Trap: dono properties ko linked maan lena.
db-dw-schema-09: Analyst ne sirf EK dimension (region) ko EK value ('North') pe fix kiya. Cube 3-D se kitne-D bacha, ye dekho.
Rule: ek dimension ek value pe fix = lower-dimensional cut. Kai dimensions par value-sets ka restriction = sub-cube. Hierarchy pe chadhna = roll-up.
Region hat gaya, time × product bacha — matlab ek cut, koi aggregation nahi. Ab options ko is rule se milao. Trap: har filter ko dice bol dena.
db-olap-cube-06: Teen grouping sets chahiye: (year, month), (year), (). (month) akela nahi chahiye — isse CUBE aur ROLLUP alag hote hain.
ROLLUP(a, b) = (a, b), (a), () — right se ek-ek column hatta hai. CUBE(a, b) = saare $2^2$ subsets.
Har option ke grouping sets likho. ROLLUP(month, year) me right se year hatega to kya bachega? Trap: column order ko ignore karna.
db-olap-cube-07: ROLLUP (city, item) hai, CUBE nahi — aur table me saare city–item pairs present nahi hain. To formula nahi, distinct groups gino.
Grouping sets: (city, item), (city), (). Har set ke liye table me distinct groups gino aur jodo.
(city, item) ke distinct pairs gino — (Jaipur, Fan) do baar hai par ek hi group. Phir distinct cities aur grand total. Trap: CUBE ki tarah item-only subtotals jodna.
db-olap-cube-08: Ulta sawaal: rows di hain, products ki ginti nikaalni hai. Saare combinations present hain, to CUBE ka full formula lagega.
$(4 + 1)(p + 1) = 40$ likho aur $p + 1$ nikaalo, phir 1 ghatao. Trap: region ka +1 bhool kar $4(p + 1) = 40$ solve karna.
db-olap-cube-09: Har cuboid dimensions ka ek subset hai. Sawaal sirf un cuboids ka hai jinme exactly 2 dimensions hain.
5 me se 2 dimensions chunne ke tareeke $= \binom{5}{2}$. Order matter nahi karta: (time, item) = (item, time).
$\binom{5}{2} = \frac{5 \cdot 4}{2}$ — ab calculate karo. Trap: $2^5$ lena, jo saare levels ke cuboids ka total hai.
db-transform-07: Naya range [−1, 1] hai, [0, 1] nahi. To pehle 0–1 wala fraction nikaalo, phir use naye range me stretch aur shift karo.
Fraction $= 360/600 = 0.6$. Ab ise naye width 2 se multiply karo aur new_min jodo. Trap: sirf 0.6 likh dena ya −1 jodna bhool jaana.
db-transform-08: Teen kaam: equal-FREQUENCY bins (4–4 values), phir second bin, phir smoothing by BOUNDARIES (mean/median nahi).
Bins: pehli 4 values, agli 4, aakhri 4. Boundary smoothing: har value bin ke min ya max me se jo paas ho, wo ban jaati hai.
Second bin = 15, 24, 49, 55; boundaries 15 aur 55. Ab 24 aur 49 ki dono boundaries se doori nikaalo. Trap: bin mean se replace kar dena.
db-transform-09: Test value 95 training range [20, 80] ke bahar hai. Clipping nahi karni — formula seedha lagao, chahe result 1 se bada aaye.
$v' = \frac{v - \min}{\max - \min}$ jahan min = 20, max = 80 training waale hi rahenge.
Numerator $95 - 20 = 75$, denominator $80 - 20 = 60$. Ab divide karo. Trap: answer ko 1 pe rok dena — no clipping kaha gaya hai.
db-sampling-06: Without replacement, 40 tuples chune gaye 800 me se. Sawaal poore sample me tuple ke hone ki probability ka hai, ek draw ka nahi.
SRSWOR me har tuple ki inclusion probability $= s/N$; yahan s = 40, N = 800.
Counting se: tuple wale samples $\binom{799}{39}$, kul samples $\binom{800}{40}$; inka ratio simplify karke formula se milao. Trap: $1/800$ (ek draw) ya SRSWR formula lagana.
db-sampling-07: Proportional stratified: pehle har region ka share nikaalo, phir har region ke andar alag-alag SRSWOR ke tareeke gino.
Share = 6 · (stratum size/12). Total samples = $\binom{8}{n_N} \cdot \binom{4}{n_S}$ — dono choices saath hoti hain, to multiply.
North share = 6 · 8/12 = 4, South = 2. $\binom{8}{4} = 70$ — ab $\binom{4}{2}$ nikaal kar multiply karo. Trap: dono ko jod dena.
db-sampling-08: Cluster sample me unit page hai, tuple nahi: 4 pages chune jaate hain aur unke saare tuples sample me aate hain.
Sample size = pages × tuples per page. Ek tuple tabhi aata hai jab uska page chuna jaaye: P = chosen pages / total pages.
Sample size $4 \times 50$ nikaalo. Probability ke liye socho: chuni jaane wali unit page hai, to 4 ko kis total se divide karna chahiye? Trap: tuples ki ginti se divide karna.
db-sampling-09: Chaar statements: SRSWOR inclusion, SRSWR inclusion, cluster vs stratified, aur samples ki ginti. Ek-ek ko formula se check karo.
SRSWOR: $P = s/N$. SRSWR: $P = 1 - (1 - 1/N)^s$. Cluster = kuch poore groups; stratified = har group se kuch.
N = 5, s = 2 ke liye $\binom{5}{2}$ aur $5^2$ nikaalo. SRSWR ke liye N = 5, s = 2 pe $1 - 0.8^2$ ko $2/5$ se compare karo. Trap: repeats ko extra chance samajhna.
